name: lendshelf-functions
description: Cloud Functions, security rules and tests for LendShelf

scripts.test:rules: node scripts/firebase.mjs emulators:exec --config ../firebase.test.json --project demo-lendshelf --only firestore,storage "vitest run --config vitest.rules.config.mts"
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && node scripts/firebase.mjs emulators:exec --config ../firebase.test.json --project demo-lendshelf --only auth,firestore,functions,storage "vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.mts"
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:unit && node scripts/firebase.mjs emulators:exec --config ../firebase.test.json --project demo-lendshelf --only auth,firestore,functions,storage "vitest run --config vitest.rules.config.mts && vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.mts"
